mechanism_narrative: Workplace mobility collapsed 10.3 points week-on-week (t-1w to t-0w, -4.6% to -16.4%), signaling a sudden lockdown or restriction event. This shock suppresses commuting and incidental retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks as the restriction regime persists.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -4.6% to -16.4% in one week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, or WORKPLACES recovers above -10% within two weeks.

Reduced transit access constrains retail accessibility for non-car users, suppressing RETAIL_REC growth over the next two weeks until alternative mobility patterns stabilize.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT declined every week from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 2 percentage points in the next two weeks, or TRANSIT recovers above -28% within one week.

failure_condition: PARKS remains below -15% for all four weeks ahead, or RETAIL_REC declines below -8% despite parks recovery.
